task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, look up information for Marriott New York, and check the weather in New York. Then create and archive a destination weather brief and alert for me in the app, book a deluxe room at Marriott New York for Alex Johnson from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13, fetch the latest business news, and finally send me a high-priority app notification when the whole trip-planning workflow is complete.
